content.text: Waking at 2am is common at 8 — it often tracks a big school-year transition, a growth phase, or stress from friendships landing in the middle of the night. The most consistent thing that helps is anchoring her day: same wake time every morning, even weekends, which pulls the whole sleep window forward and makes the 2am wake harder to sustain.

input.offer: Want the full plan for getting Ada back to sleeping through? Say YES and I'll send it.
